auth.signInSubtitle: Sign in to continue to your workspace.
auth.forgotHint: Forgot your password? Ask an admin to reset it — they will give you a reset link (or a temporary password that requires choosing a new one).
auth.setupSubtitle: Welcome. Set up the first administrator to manage this workspace.
auth.resetSubtitle: Choose a new password for your account.

projects.title: Projects
projects.managementSubtitle: Create projects and manage their settings.
projects.exploreSubtitle: Select a project to explore metrics, charts, and dashboards.
projects.noWarehousesHint: No warehouses exist yet. Create one to connect this project to Trino.

create.title: Create project
create.subtitle: Add a new project to organize dashboards, charts, and metrics.

edit.title: Project settings
edit.subtitle: Update the project name, warehouse connection, Git repository settings, and table links.
edit.dangerText: Permanently delete this project and all of its spaces, dashboards, and saved charts. Warehouse connections are kept.
edit.deleteConfirm: Delete this project permanently? All spaces, dashboards, and saved charts will be removed. This cannot be undone.

git.title: Git repository
git.subtitle: Optional. Point this project at a dbt repo to clone locally for semantic layer artifacts.
git.subdirectoryHint: Path to the dbt project within the repository, if not at the root.
git.bitbucketUsernameHint: Required for Bitbucket Cloud HTTP access tokens / app passwords.
git.bitbucketTokenHint: Bitbucket Cloud HTTP access token or app password.
git.privateTokenHint: For private repositories. Stored encrypted on the server.
git.savedTokenHint: A token is saved. Leave blank to keep it, or check clear below.
git.removeConfirm: Remove the local clone for this project? Git settings are kept so you can sync again later.

dbt.title: dbt project
dbt.subtitle: Optional. Local path to your dbt project when not using Git sync. Relative paths are resolved from the backend directory.
dbt.pathHint: Overrides DBT_PROJECT_PATH from .env for this project. Requires target/manifest.json (run dbt compile).
dbt.pathHintEdit: Local dbt directory for this project. Relative to mds-backend/. Cleared on desync only when the path pointed at the cloned repo.
dbt.targetHint: Optional profiles.yml target used for dbt parse after Git sync.
dbt.targetHintEdit: Optional profiles.yml target passed to dbt parse after sync (e.g. dev or parse).

warehouses.title: Warehouses
warehouses.subtitle: Manage reusable database connections for your projects.
warehouses.editSubtitle: Configure a reusable Trino connection for your projects.
warehouses.deleteConfirm: Delete this warehouse connection? Projects using it will be unassigned.
warehouses.formSubtitle: Configure a database connection for projects to fetch live data.
warehouses.passwordStored: A password is stored for this connection.
warehouses.testTrinoOnly: Connection testing is only available for Trino warehouses.
warehouses.testRequired: Host, port, and username are required to test the connection.

hints.oracleService: Optional. Oracle service name or SID.

create.title: Create user
create.note: A temporary password will be generated. Share it with the user — they must change it on first sign-in.

password.resetConfirm: Reset password for {{email}}? A new temporary password will be generated for you to copy.
password.firstSignInMessage: Copy this temporary password and send it to the user. They must change it on first sign-in.
password.nextSignInMessage: Copy this temporary password and send it to the user. They must change it on next sign-in.
password.missing: User saved, but no temporary password was returned.
